title: pong (MIT, SDL2) ported with the yield shim

toolchain.emccVersion: emcc (Emscripten gcc/clang-like replacement + linker emulating GNU ld) 6.0.12-git

blockers.fix: Convert to emscripten_set_main_loop, or build with -sASYNCIFY so the blocking loop yields to the browser.
